verdict.rationale: Codex CLI can run locally, but the core capability depends on OpenAI's hosted models via a ChatGPT account or API key (codex-gh-3, codex-gh-4, codex-gh-7); there is no evidence of a self-hostable model/inference backend or on-prem deployment option. The CLI/agent shell being open-source on GitHub does not equate to self-hosting the core product, since the underlying model remains a cloud-only OpenAI service.
